command: async (page) => {  const pid='team_kraken_unit_p0';  const getRoster=async()=> (await (await page.request.get(new URL('/api/roster/team_nexus',page.url()).href)).json()).players.map(p=>({id:p.id,dev_focus:p.dev_focus,training_intensity:p.training_intensity,learning_language:p.learning_language,starter:p.starter}));  const before=await getRoster(); const observations=[];  for (const [field,value,param] of [['focus','tactical','dev_focus'],['intensity','light','intensity']]) {   const row=page.locator('tr').filter({has:page.locator('td span.plink[data-pid="'+pid+'"]')});   if(await row.count()!==1)throw new Error('Expected one identity-scoped row');   const select=row.locator('select[data-act="'+field+'"]');if(await select.count()!==1)throw new Error('Expected one row control');   const pending=page.waitForResponse(response=>{if(response.request().method()!=='POST'||!response.url().endsWith('/api/actions/dev_plan'))return false;const body=response.request().postDataJSON();return body.player_id===pid&&body[param]===value;});   await select.selectOption(value);const response=await pending;   observations.push({field,value,status:response.status(),request:response.request().postDataJSON(),result:await response.json(),roster:await getRoster()});  }  return {before,observations,after:await getRoster()}; }
